original.target_description: Original single experiment: SOA (1–10 items) × temporal-selection measure (efficacy, latency, precision) × target (T1, T2) three-way interaction testing whether selection measures follow different time courses. The p. 5 locator corresponds to printed p. 59; this is the explicit numbered omnibus test on that page spanning all three dimensions.

notes: Identity independently checked in supplied canonical text: portal cover identifies Vul, Nieuwenstein, and Kanwisher (2008), Psychological Science 19(1), 55–61, DOI 10.1111/j.1467-9280.2008.02046.x, and labels document Publisher’s PDF / Version of record. Article title and author byline agree with neutral original reference; canonical text includes full article through references and appendix, rather than only an abstract. No source PDF path supplied; no PDF acquired or rendered. Only es_value_o and pval_value_o assigned. All other fields and replication side are placeholders. The article fifth-page locator identifies the reported SOA × measure × target three-way ANOVA, covering efficacy/latency/precision together. The same paragraph also says all effects and interactions were significant at a p value of .0001, but that general statement is not substituted for the explicitly paired three-way p < .00001. Printed p. 60 separately reports delay at maximal SOA, t(11) = 5.98, p < .0001, and recovery-time suppression versus diffusion, t(11) = 2.7, p < .05; these are outside the supplied p. 5 locator and are not substituted. Canonical extraction uses character 5 for the equality glyph; test_statistic normalizes it to =, while the evidence quote retains literal canonical text. No metric conversion, N derivation, or success inference performed.
